items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby. Downgraded practices (FP to LP to DNP); HC says will do best to play, traveling.
items.why: Ankle + added foot; Friday DNP after Thursday limited.
items.implication: Game-time; if out, backup (Hemby/Washington) near one-for-one; if in, possible limited workload.
items.opportunity: Monitor for active; elevated backup if OUT.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; no deal completed until after Sunday games. Tenure in AZ done.
items.why: Trade imminent; team comfortable enough with offer to sideline him.
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 5; targets shift to remaining ARI WRs long-term destination TBD (HOU interest).
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and other ARI pass-catchers elevated role immediately; ROS value depends on landing spot.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for Eagles vs JAX in London.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week, week-to-week.
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR corps depleted; backup RBs and remaining WRs see expanded opportunity.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs (e.g. Gainwell if applicable) and secondary WRs/TEs elevated snaps/targets.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT Week 5 (ankle) for Ravens vs ATL; missed practice after leaving Week 4 early.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; Ravens pass game and rush threat diminished; Andrews/Likely/Henry usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely and Mark Andrews potential target bumps; Derrick Henry volume may rise or game script change.

items.text: Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum four games.
items.implication: PIT WR depth chart reshuffle for multiple weeks; DK Metcalf and others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining PIT WRs.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT Week 5 (quad) vs CLE; second straight miss.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup primary; reduced offense overall.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT Week 5 (hamstring) for Commanders; Terry McLaurin questionable.
items.implication: WAS WR targets concentrate on McLaurin (if active) and others; short-area TE usage up.
items.opportunity: McLaurin target share increase if plays; secondary WRs/TEs.

items.text: Quentin Johnston OUT Week 5; Ladd McConkey questionable for Chargers.
items.implication: LAC WR targets to McConkey (if active) and others.
items.opportunity: McConkey route/target share up if plays.

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN and expected to start Week 5 vs NYG after full practice; wearing brace post-elbow dislocation.
items.why: Upgraded to full participant; HC confirms start.
items.implication: WAS offense returns to dual-threat QB; boosts all pass-catchers and his rushing floor.
items.opportunity: Full snap share at QB; elevated efficiency for McLaurin/others.

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN for Week 5; Olave with Noah Fant, Goedert after prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Full roles expected; reverse any stale backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Olave target share locked in NO; Goedert TE1 snaps/routes with PHI WRs out.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance, full-go per player); ETR projects 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger workload expected after Week 4 usage criticism. Tough projection spot but upgrade.
items.why: Not on final report; media/fan pressure on prior low usage; gut for better role.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with expanded carries/routes vs DET; Allgeier handcuff lower.
items.opportunity: Projected clear lead back; higher snap/carry share, red-zone potential.
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance risk and long-season wear remain downside.

items.text: Adam Levitan notes multi-risk stack for Malik Nabers long-term: knee (missed practice sore), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low second-half targets Week 4. Still good play this week.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; short-term startable but volatility rising.
items.opportunity: Current role intact but long-term snap/target risk if issues compound.
items.conflict: Near-term volume still elite if healthy.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft Titans secondary.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; red-zone volume.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 (pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname); workload + soft defense, boosted by potential Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Target/carry gobbler vs carve-up MIA run D; Bengals injury context.
